interpretation: SNpp39 and SNpp41 are both evidence-backed FeCO hook types. Published physiology establishes extension- and flexion-sensitive hook populations, and connectome work identifies SNpp39/SNpp41 as two opposing hook connectivity types, but the reviewed evidence used here does not directly assign SNpp39 versus SNpp41 to the extension versus flexion sensory tuning labels. Direction-specific neural stimulation therefore remains blocked.

rejected_candidates.reason: SNpp40/SNpp50/SNpp51 also occur in subclass=leg; SNpp51 additionally has a same-name unknown_sensory/leg row. Class/subclass gates were not relaxed.

mappings.downstream_effect_summary: connectome-predicted flexor-favoring / extensor-inhibiting circuit effect; not used as a sensory tuning label
